hypothesis_H.statement: the convention (iii) blow-up of the unconfined masked arm is located in the mask-dropped frames

thresholds.threshold_provenance: the two convention thresholds are transcribed verbatim from the frozen spec; the outside-mask share threshold is the majority reading of the spec's qualitative location claim, fixed before the probe ran, and the raw share is reported for every point

decision_rule.verdict: the outside-mask split locates the blow-up, but confinement does not lift convention (iii) to nonnegative for ; that family cannot be helped by this ansatz at any measured rank and v15 must route it to abstention with output bit-identical to the parent

protocol.basis: per-family raw residual temporal POD over the two frozen v1 basis records, nested truncation to ranks 8/16/32, v1 sign rule

conventions.ii_masked_energy_floored_per_frame: mean over frames with ||truth_t||^2 >= tau*max_s||truth_s||^2 of sqrt(||err_t||^2 / max(||truth_t||^2, tau*max_s||truth_s||^2))

protocol.error_energy_split: sum of per-frame squared error inside and outside the keep mask, reported for parent, unconfined and confined; the headline split uses the parent-energy mask
protocol.mask_causality: the confinement gate uses only parent frame energy, which is available at deployment; the truth mask appears only in the labelled diagnostic

variants.confined: identical fit, correction multiplied by the parent-energy keep mask before it is applied, so it is exactly zero on dropped frames
variants.truth_mask_confined: labelled diagnostic only, not deployment-causal, never the headline
variants.unconfined: the r4e8 masked_matched arm verbatim: weighted LS on truth-mask retained frames with floored denominators, correction applied to every future frame

why: the r4e8 masked_matched arm fits on retained frames but applies the correction to every frame; hypothesis H says the convention (iii) blow-up lives in the dropped frames
